title: 允许员工子账号使用客服聊天
problem: 员工访问闸门默认拒绝整个 /support 路径，导致客服聊天 POST /api/qingpu/support/chat 在进入业务逻辑前返回 403。
expectedOutcome: 有效员工子账号可以使用客服聊天及读取聊天可用状态，同时诊断接口与其他支持域端点仍保持默认拒绝。
constraints: 仅精确放行 POST /support/chat 和只读 /support/status，不放行整个 /support 前缀
继续禁止员工访问 /support/diagnose，避免暴露账号、任务、发布或订阅诊断上下文
不修改客服聊天业务、会话归属、店主权限或设备令牌行为
保留工作区全部既有并行改动，不提交、推送或部署
acceptanceCriteria: member 和 manager 均可 POST /api/qingpu/support/chat
member 和 manager 均可 GET 或 HEAD /api/qingpu/support/status
员工仍不能访问 /api/qingpu/support/diagnose 或其他 /support 子路径
店主现有访问行为不变

verification.name: 员工客服权限边界
verification.command: ../../../node_modules/.bin/tsx -e "const { isEmployeeAllowed } = await import('./server/employees/access.ts'); for (const role of ['member','manager'] as const) { if (!isEmployeeAllowed('/api/qingpu/support/chat', 'POST', role)) throw new Error(role + ' cannot chat'); if (!isEmployeeAllowed('/api/qingpu/support/status', 'GET', role)) throw new Error(role + ' cannot read status'); for (const [path, method] of [['/api/qingpu/support/chat','GET'], ['/api/qingpu/support/status','POST'], ['/api/qingpu/support/diagnose','POST'], ['/api/qingpu/support/anything','GET']] as const) if (isEmployeeAllowed(path, method, role)) throw new Error(role + ' unexpectedly allowed ' + method + ' ' + path); } console.log('employee support access boundaries verified')"
